From: Aisha Rahman <aisha@redwood.com>

Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 May 2027 15:42:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo: SOC2 packet sent — any blockers?

Hi Oliver — thanks again for taking the demo with us today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so everything is on the same page:

- Key notes from call: Wildwood wants predictable inference latency for batch scoring, plus clear audit trails for requests tied to customer data retention policies.
- I shared our SOC 2 packet and the demo recording (attached). The packet includes our control mapping, data flows, and incident response summary.

Attachments:
- Redwood_SOC2_v2.pdf (PDF, 2.4MB)
- demo-recording-20270530.mp4 (link stub)

Open asks / next steps:
1) Can you confirm who on your side will own the security review (name/email)?
2) Do you have timeline constraints for procurement / legal to finish review?
3) Any initial blockers we should be aware of (e.g., data residency, encryption requirements, custom logging)?

If it helps, Marcus (cc'd) can join a 20-minute checkpoint with your security lead to walk through the packet and call out anything that needs a written response. I can also share a short Q&A doc with suggested answers.

Proposing: Tue 6/1 or Wed 6/2, 10–11am PT or 2–3pm PT. If those don't work, send a couple times that do.

Cheers,
Aisha Rahman
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
A: aisha@redwood.com | M: (415) 555-0172

[Attachment: Redwood_SOC2_v2.pdf]

Hi Aisha — appreciate the follow-up and the packet. I shared the PDF and the recording with our InfoSec lead (security@wildwood.ai). A couple quick items:

- Timeline: we aim to complete vendor security reviews within 10 business days, so you should hear back by next week.
- Question: does Redwood have any region-specific data retention templates (we're evaluating US vs EU retention controls)?

I'll put our security lead on a separate thread if they have detailed Qs. For now, thank you — we'll be in touch.
